name: "Diamond" Jack Tatum
caption: RVRL's reclusive founder, who reacquired the promotion's name and archives in 2006 and reopened it as a regional revival.

tenures.source: RVRL's own founding history and FAQ, first posted 15 May 2006.

name: Casey Blain
caption: RVRL's host and lead interviewer, calling the promotion's 2006 revival opener from Little Rock.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Roy Hardee
caption: The ring announcer for RVRL's 2006 revival, introducing every bout on the Little Rock opener.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Aries Priest
caption: A former mixed-martial-arts champion who reached the second round of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament before losing to Colt Daniels.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.
tenures.note: Managed to the ring by Darius Walker.

name: "Reverend" Al Horton
caption: A preacher-gimmick wrestler eliminated in the first round of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament by Aries Priest.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Darius Walker
caption: Aries Priest's manager, whose interference twice turned matches in the 2006 Heavyweight title tournament.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: "The Motor City's Own" Bryan McCormick
caption: A Detroit-based wrestler eliminated in the first round of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament by Colt Daniels.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Colt Daniels
caption: A young Texan who reached the finals of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament before losing the title match to "Rabid" Rob Cole.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Jay Himalay
caption: Won RVRL's 2006 Missouri Valley Heavyweight Championship tournament final over Aries Priest, using a foreign object and a handful of tights.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: The Masked Krishna
caption: A meditative, flower-bearing wrestler eliminated in the first round of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament by Jay Himalay.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Jake Evans
caption: A veteran brawler eliminated in the first round of RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight title tournament by "Rabid" Rob Cole after a weapon shot.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: "Rabid" Rob Cole
caption: Won RVRL's 2006 Heavyweight Championship tournament final over Colt Daniels with an illegal weapon shot.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Rick Russell
caption: A newly signed RVRL veteran who ran in from the crowd to help Colt Daniels against Aries Priest and his manager in the 2006 tournament.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: "Dust Devil" Watkins
caption: A newly signed RVRL wrestler billed as the son of "the legendary Chet Watkins," introduced to the crowd at the 2006 revival opener.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: Johnny Midas
caption: A talent agent who confronted new RVRL Heavyweight Champion "Rabid" Rob Cole after the 2006 title tournament final and set his own client on him.

tenures.source: RVRL's own Thursday Night Rage broadcast, 8 June 2006.

name: "The Brazilian Heatseeker" Fabricio Silva
caption: A masked wrestler brought in by manager Johnny Midas to attack new RVRL Heavyweight Champion "Rabid" Rob Cole immediately after his 2006 title win.
